title: Motion (McOsker - Padilla) relative to temporarily closing Flint Avenue from G Street to Pioneer Avenue, Pioneer Avenue from Flint Avenue to G Street, and…
text:
[Council File 26-1219; CD 15]
Motion (McOsker - Padilla) relative to temporarily closing Flint Avenue from G Street to Pioneer Avenue, Pioneer Avenue from Flint Avenue to G Street, and the Y-shaped alley adjacent to Pioneer Avenue south of G Street and east of Flint Avenue.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to temporarily close Flint Avenue and Pioneer Avenue between G Street, plus a Y-shaped alley beside Pioneer Avenue.
